results.ground_truth: I have worked on or bought five model kits. The scales of the models are: Revell F-15 Eagle (scale not mentioned), Tamiya 1/48 scale Spitfire Mk.V, 1/16 scale German Tiger I tank, 1/72 scale B-29 bomber, and 1/24 scale '69 Camaro.
15 hours for getting to the three destinations (or 30 hours for the round trip)
I visited three different doctors: a primary care physician, an ENT specialist, and a dermatologist.
I attended three weddings. The couples were Rachel and Mike, Emily and Sarah, and Jen and Tom.

I viewed four properties before making an offer on the townhouse in the Brookside neighborhood. The reasons I didn't make an offer on them were: the kitchen of the bungalow needed serious renovation, the property in Cedar Creek was out of my budget, the noise from the highway was a deal-breaker for the 1-bedroom condo, and my offer on the 2-bedroom condo was rejected due to a higher bid.
5 days. 6 days (including the last day) is also acceptable.

I currently own 4 musical instruments. I've had the Fender Stratocaster electric guitar for 5 years, the Yamaha FG800 acoustic guitar for 8 years, the 5-piece Pearl Export drum set for an unspecified amount of time, and the Korg B1 piano for 3 years.
